instruction: A store has 2400 items. It sells 12.5% of them on Monday. On Tuesday it sells 20% of the items left, rounded down to whole items. How many items remain? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
